text:
Sam: T-minus 45m for service-x rollout (window 22:00-22:30 UTC). Quick preflight list - who is on rollback, who owns smoke, any migration gating?

Ingrid: I'll own prod smoke. I'll run the smoke checklist and report back. LB warmup + sample hits, schema validation on read path.

Matt: Primary rollback owner. If we see error-rate > 3% or latency spike > 2x for 5m, I'll trigger rollback. Rollback plan: flip flag + emergency redeploy. Runbook: https://intra/runbooks/service-x-rollback

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy queued by matt at 2026-03-18T22:00:00Z (job id: 8421). Canary lane: 1% -> 10% -> 100% with 5m observation.

Keon: Note: there's a small migration (backfill index) kicking at +30m. I've set it to 'paused' until canary green. Migration job 6789. Feature flag 'service_x_v2' is currently OFF in prod.

Jess: Staging smoke completed 18:40 UTC — no regression on critical paths. Confirming staging biometrics queries.

Sam: Can everyone please post a quick 'ack' + role? I'll mark final green.

Ingrid: ack — smoke owner

Matt: ack — rollback

Keon: ack — migrations, will unpause after canary ok

Jess: ack — staging verification

Sam: OK: Final GO in 10m unless any blockers. I'll ping again at T-minus 5. :thumbsup:

Matt: Ping when you start canary so I can watch dashboards.

Ingrid: I'll start smoke 2m after canary starts and post results.

deploy-bot: Canary stage started at 2026-03-18T22:02:00Z (canary id 8421-canary). Observing metrics.

Ingrid: smoke: LB warmup ok, 20 sample queries passed, no errors so far.

Matt: watching traces and error budgets. No anomalies at 2m.

Keon: keeping migration paused.

Sam: final ack from PM side? (cc @product)

Jess: PM gave verbal go earlier. proceeding.

Sam: rolling. I'll post status updates and final completion.

deploy-bot: Rollout completed to 100% at 2026-03-18T22:12:34Z. No automatic rollbacks triggered.

Matt: doing post-deploy sanity. All good from rollback POV.

Ingrid: smoke passed full rollout. closing smoke checklist.

Keon: unpausing migration now.

Sam: Thanks team. Closing thread. :party:
